label: Slack
what: Unread direct messages and mentions, with a short preview.

credentials.label: Slack user token
credentials.help: A user token from your own Slack app.

reads: Direct messages and group messages newer than your last-read marker.
Channels where you were mentioned since you last read them. A 100 character preview of each.
not_reads: It never marks anything read and never posts.
steps: Go to api.slack.com/apps and create an app for your workspace, from scratch.
Under OAuth and Permissions add the ten User Token Scopes listed here. Use user scopes, not bot scopes.
Install the app to your workspace. Your workspace may need an admin to approve it.
Copy the User OAuth Token. It starts with xoxp-.
Paste it here and save. Then switch Slack on.
revoke: At api.slack.com/apps open your app and choose Revoke tokens, or uninstall it from the workspace. Then remove the token here.
tested: Parsing tested against sample data only; not tested against the real service. Method names were written from Slack's documentation.
